name: Nobeyama 45 m radio telescope
place: Nobeyama Radio Observatory, near Minamimaki, Nagano
description: A 45-metre millimetre-wave radio telescope at 1,350 m altitude, part of the National Astronomical Observatory of Japan. It operates across 1-80 GHz and studies star formation and galaxy evolution.
highlights: Built in 1982 with positioning errors under 0.1 mm.
NAOJ credits it with advancing Japanese radio astronomy to world-class standards.
It has operated for over 40 years.
